propositions: Add LLMRuntime capability type in src/rebar/llm/auth.py to hold provider-native auth/session inputs without serialization or inclusion in config/request/snapshot/cache/schema
Extend PydanticAIRunner and get_runner to accept optional LLMRuntime and pass it only into the single per-run ProviderSession builder for provider-native client construction
Fail before a provider model request if explicit auth is absent or conflicting, without fallback to anonymous, alternate principal, or cross-provider candidate
Preserve RP-01 policy: request budget, output repair, cache, exhaustion, artifact, tracing, usage, and failure behavior remain unchanged through the single per-run Agent operation
Provider-native auth refresh, expiry, and workload identity remain under SDK ownership; Rebar owns client construction/closure and retains policy enforcement
